name: The Core
_comment: 025: Act 3's gate and the run's last fight. The Core is bolted to its hex and pulses the ring around it every third round; flues ring the chamber. The escorts are rolled by the run at the other enemy positions; as a file it is a complete fight for practice and tests.
_038: play-test 11: the end boss -- 72 HP, two conduits that shield it (authored keepers, not rolled), a dressed floor
_083: A1: the keeper's fall ends the fight ("keeper": true on its spec; RunSim copies the spec). A2: `escort_waves` -- the last rolled escorts are held back and arrive on hexes marked a round ahead (at least one starts on the board). B5: `pile_heal` 0, a boss fight does not heal; piles still pay scrap.
_083b: the user (2026-10-22): a bit less HP but more threatening -- 72 -> 60 HP; enemy_kinds.heart: pulses every round, guns +2 (`damage`), erupts for 6. Measured on run-built Act 3 gates: 8.3 -> 7.5 rounds, crew HP lost 8.4 -> 9.1, timeouts 1 -> 0 of 100.
_088: A6 (engagement review: one opener -- a lance into the drum by the spawn -- solved turn 1 here every time): the two drums stand on one of five pairs of hexes (`prop_slots`, picked per fight by SimRNG; the original pair is the first), and in a run the chamber is reflected left-right half the time (`mirror`).
